name: QFlipper
description: HTTPS enforced, but firmware has no signature/hash check — only DFU-format magic bytes.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: QFlipper’s update registry validates the structure of firmware channel metadata. Firmware recovery and device-side validation are separate boundaries; the reviewed host code does not establish the full firmware-authentication policy.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; device-side firmware validation, release metadata provenance, and channels outside the reviewed registry/install path were not independently audited.
